classical-e2e-fixtures-incompatible-with.closure_condition: Inventory the 16 affected E2E scripts as retained or retired. Every retained path must obtain deterministic PQ initial validators from one shared helper, boot a real PQ chain in branch CI, and exercise its advertised route; this includes localnet-jsonrpc.py and its TOSCAN consumer. Retired paths must be removed from release claims and entry-point inventories rather than left executable but dead.
classical-e2e-fixtures-incompatible-with.observation: The retained inventory is 15 E2E entry-point files with 16 initial-validator call sites because dns-e2e.py owns two networks. Production manager admission refuses their former classical descriptors on the PQ consensus path, completes synchronization with zero validating groups, and never reaches masterchain seqno 1. All 16 sites now consume one deterministic PQ helper and an exact source inventory refuses direct classical or low-level PQ provisioning. The first real execution pass is recorded by entry point in N6-STATUS-FOR-REVIEW.md: seven routes pass through their advertised endpoint, while eight reach named post-bootstrap failures. An independently built origin/main control at 2004ce5e6 classifies four as pre-existing (ambiguous wallet broadcast, one shared missing-quorum-config fixture affecting two routes, and service_show chain RPC) and four as PQ regressions (observer groups, DNS governance activation, nominator validator funding, and validator stake authorization). The two 600-second staking controls progressed beyond the PQ failure boundary before timing out later and are not claimed as whole-route passes. At discovery, no branch CI job booted a chain: build-tos-linux-x86-64-shared.yml declared on.push.branches=[main], while tosctl-service.yml declared jobs.real-chain-explorer.if as github.event_name == 'workflow_dispatch' (observed skipped on run 35748202781). branch-chain-python.yml now runs the complete Python suite and the four-validator PQ wallet/transfer chain on every push and pull request, preventing that execution-coverage cause from recurring.

classical-stake-producers-incompatible-w.closure_condition: The shared tosctl nominator::new_stake builder refuses non-ML-DSA-44 signatures locally; both tosctl election paths obtain PQ stake authorization from engine.validator.createPqStakeAuthorization and emit the PQ stake body; the single-nominator-pool operator path obtains the same node-produced authorization and emits the PQ message shape its already-converted contract parses; and liquid-staking remains excluded from launch claims and entry-point inventories until its controller contract is converted using single-nominator-pool as the worked example. The base validator-elect Fift tools may be removed only in the same change that migrates every retained caller, updates test-smartcont.cpp, and leaves neither pool tooling nor tests with dangling references.
classical-stake-producers-incompatible-w.observation: The PQ elector rejects the classical 0x654C5074 stake authorization, but the two base validator-election Fift tools, Validator.fif's validator-elect-req>B word, the C++ smart-contract test, two Fift proposal tests, two Python election scripts, both pool operator scripts, and three tosctl paths still produce or consume it: the election daemon, the interactive bid command, and the nominator-pool config-wallet command. single-nominator-pool's contract is already converted: it relays through its controller and parses algorithm id, public key, signature and optional witness; only its operator script is stale. liquid-staking's controller still sends classical new_stake directly to the elector and handles new_stake_ok/new_stake_error, so liquid-staking is not launch-supported. Pooled staking remains in the launch set through the converted single-nominator path; liquid-staking must not appear in a release claim until its contract-level conversion is complete.

merkle-base-state-mismatch.closure_condition: A run-evidenced diagnosis identifies whether the mismatched candidate state_update and base state are selected by production consensus or by the test fixture, followed by a guard that fails when that demonstrated ordering is reintroduced.
merkle-base-state-mismatch.observation: A candidate state_update was applied to a base state root it was not produced against during test-consensus-simplex2-pq-finality-e2e-100 under whole-suite parallel load.
